instrument: The instrument was exact on every pre-registered check: all 1,319 endpoints reproduced byte for byte on a second machine before any neighbourhood was evaluated, all 141 repeated neighbourhoods agreed exactly, and no placement failed.
caption: SOMEWHERE ELSE. One row per parent, 88 rows in parents.json order. Left to right: the parent, then its first walk's neutral descendants at 8, 16, 32, 48 and 60 bytes' distance, each drawn as a walk from its bytes with THREADS' pen: faint, the whole program; black, the part it executes; red, three or more instructions. Beneath each, a bar of 64 cells, one per byte position, inked by the fraction of that position's 255 one-byte changes that alter what the program does. Every genome in a row does exactly the same thing. If neutral history changed nothing about what is reachable next, every bar in a row would be the same bar. Rules fixed and hashed before the run.

hypotheses.name: neighbourhood divergence with neutral distance
hypotheses.registered: The dissimilarity between an endpoint's one-mutant neighbourhood and its parent's, measured coarsely on the five classes (D5) and finely on exact signatures (Dsig), by distance target 8, 16, 32, 48, 60. Parents are the unit of inference: three walks summarised within parent by their median, uncertainty from resampling parents. No directional threshold. Pre-listed readings: (a) not distinguishable from zero at every target; (b) above zero at the first target and flat afterwards; (c) rising with neutral travel; (d) at the matched reference by target 60.
hypotheses.observed: Dsig by target (mean over parents of the within-parent median): 8: 0.0013, 16: 0.0026, 32: 0.0046, 48: 0.0065, 60: 0.0077; Spearman's rho over parent medians against target 0.79 (parent bootstrap 0.76 to 0.83). D5 by target: 8: 0.0002, 16: 0.0004, 32: 0.0008, 48: 0.0012, 60: 0.0015; rho 0.64 (0.58 to 0.69). Against realised Hamming, rho 0.74; against Hamming inside the parent's expressed region, 0.52. References: unrelated parents with the identical full signature, Dsig 0.009 (0.008 to 0.010) over 60 parents; unrelated parents matched on lifespan only, 0.402 (0.304 to 0.500).
hypotheses.verdict: (c) rising with neutral travel, and still below the matched reference at target 60
hypotheses.note: Dsig is a lower bound on phenotypic difference: two children with the same signature may differ in ways the signature does not record.

hypotheses.name: accessibility without phenotypic change
hypotheses.registered: For each endpoint, the set of signatures reachable in one mutation against its parent's: Jaccard(S) and Dsig. Decision rule fixed in advance: an endpoint's neighbourhood differs from its parent's if Dsig > 0 or Jaccard(S) < 1, provided the reproducibility check passed with every replicate distance exactly zero. The fraction differing, by target, with a parent-level bootstrap. No threshold on the size of the difference.
hypotheses.observed: Reproducibility check: 141 of 141 re-evaluated neighbourhoods agreed exactly, so the rule applies as written. Endpoints whose neighbourhood differs from the parent's: at 8, 100.0% (100.0% to 100.0%); at 16, 100.0% (100.0% to 100.0%); at 32, 100.0% (100.0% to 100.0%); at 48, 100.0% (100.0% to 100.0%); at 60, 100.0% (100.0% to 100.0%). Jaccard(S) by target: 8: 0.982, 16: 0.963, 32: 0.932, 48: 0.902, 60: 0.870.
hypotheses.verdict: every endpoint differs from its parent, at every target
hypotheses.note: The rule is sensitive by construction: one differing child among 16,319 is enough, so this fraction records that a difference exists, not how large it is; the size is X1's result.

hypotheses.name: accessible variation
hypotheses.registered: Three quantities per genome, as paired differences endpoint minus parent, by target: adjacent variation (the fraction of children whose signature differs from the genome's), phenotypic richness (distinct child signatures), upward accessibility (the fraction of children that outlive the genome on probe A). Pre-listed readings: unchanged; changed in one direction across parents; changed without a consistent direction. No threshold.
hypotheses.verdict: adjacent variation approximately unchanged (the interval excludes zero only at target 16, by under a hundredth of a percentage point, with no consistent trajectory); richness down at targets 48, 60; upward accessibility unchanged at every target
hypotheses.note: The word evolvability is not used.

hypotheses.name: exact against aggregate
hypotheses.registered: For each endpoint–parent pair, the Jaccard overlap of the exact sets of non-neutral (position, value) substitutions, reported as the difference from its exact random-subset expectation (hypergeometric), beside D5 and Dsig, by target. The question is whether exact mutational overlap declines along the targets while the aggregate accessibility distances stay comparatively small, read beside the matched references. Reported as it appears; no binary classification.
hypotheses.observed: Observed Jaccard(M) by target: 8: 0.996, 16: 0.992, 32: 0.985, 48: 0.971, 60: 0.925. Random-subset expectation for independent sets of the same sizes: about 0.024 at every target. Excess above that expectation: 8: 0.972, 16: 0.968, 32: 0.961, 48: 0.947, 60: 0.901. Observed exact overlap remains far above random expectation after sixty bytes of neutral travel; Jaccard is intersection over union and is not converted into a fraction retained. Beside it, D5 8: 0.0002, 16: 0.0004, 32: 0.0008, 48: 0.0012, 60: 0.0015 and Dsig 8: 0.0013, 16: 0.0026, 32: 0.0046, 48: 0.0065, 60: 0.0077.
hypotheses.verdict: a large conserved structure with a smaller component rearranging: observed overlap 0.996 at 8 to 0.925 at 60, about 0.024 by chance; D5 at most 0.0015, Dsig at most 0.0077
hypotheses.note: A Jaccard(M) far above its expectation means the two programs share their exact fragile positions; near it, they share only as much as strangers would.

hypotheses.name: nothing new, observation only
hypotheses.registered: E2's detectors, unchanged, over every child, plus self-inspection (CODESIZE, CODECOPY, ADDRESS, EXTCODEHASH of self executed). Incidence reported. Nothing predicted, nothing rewarded. child_has_code and calls that enter code are replicated three times before being reported as more than candidates.
hypotheses.observed: Children reaching each event, over 1,407 neighbourhoods: self_inspection 2,142,809, clean_halt 270,447, returns_data 219, create_executed 195, write_survives 147. Genomes with a child that left code behind: 0. Genomes with a child whose call entered code: 0.
hypotheses.note: The scorecard moves only as E2 §9 specified.

sentences: A program's neutral descendants, which still do exactly what it does under the frozen measurement, do not keep exactly its immediate futures: their one-mutant neighbourhoods diverge from its own, by a little at eight bytes and by more at every target after, in step with neutral distance.

The amount of adjacent variation does not change with the travel: the share of children that behave differently, and the share that outlive the genome, are the same sixty bytes away as at home, while the exact mutations that matter slowly rearrange, their overlap still high at sixty bytes but fallen, a Jaccard of 0.996 at eight bytes and 0.925 at sixty.

Two programs can do the same measured thing without being in the same place: silent history does not add or remove possibility so much as rearrange which possibilities are one mutation away, changing the shape of the next step without changing the present.
facts: 88 E2 parents, 42 genesis and 46 control, fixed in E2/parents.json before E2 ran
1,319 neutral descendants: three fresh walks per parent frozen at the first accepted step reaching Hamming 8, 16, 32, 48 and 60; one walk ended its 2,000-attempt budget at 59 and contributes four
1,407 exhaustive, 16,319 placeable children each, plus 141 re-evaluated on separate chains for the reproducibility check
0 placement failures excluded from every statistic; 0 placements with the detector transaction unavailable
1319 of 1319 endpoints identical, byte for byte, between the droplet and a second machine before any neighbourhood was evaluated
the 88 parents' neighbourhoods under E1's harness against E3's, D5 0.012 (0.001 to 0.033), exploratory
v0, frozen as in E1 and E2; every genotype evaluated from the same clean chain state at the same address
